ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_weighted_mean_affine_invariant
ir.intuition: Corrected affine invariance violation by removing the fixed offset on cost_gap and instead scaling the margin linearly with the cost gap, preserving shift-scale invariance. Kept weighted mean aggregation for stability and included only required keys. This ensures the loss respects affine transformations of the objective signal, passing co_gate.
ir.pseudocode:
loss_i = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w_i - log_prob_l_i - 0.1 * cost_gap_i), -20, 20))
final_loss = sum(weight_i * loss_i) / sum(weight_i)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    margin = 0.1 * cost_gap
    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl - margin)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    weighted_loss = loss * weight
    return weighted_loss.sum() / (weight.sum() + eps)
